highlight.header2: What I learned from talking with two MLB CFOs
highlight.point1: The Yankees Finance Dept. Sucks. They spend so much on players because they don't know how much they have to spend.
highlight.point2: The SF Giants Finance Dept is top notch. Probably over analyzed the benefit analysis of paying Devers.
highlight.point3: MLB Finance Dept have very little to do with the success of the team.
